description: This file provides debug support utilities for voice wake recognition, including transcript logging, command matching, and summary generation.

classes.name: TranscriptSummary
classes.description: A struct representing a summary of voice transcript, indicating if it's text-only and the count of timing segments.

methods.name: shouldLogTranscript
methods.description: Determines whether the transcript should be logged based on content, logging level, and timing constraints.

methods.name: textOnlyFallbackMatch
methods.description: Attempts to match a transcript with trigger words using a text-only approach and a specified trimming function.

methods.name: transcriptSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of the transcript, indicating if it's text-only and counting its segments.

methods.name: matchSummary
methods.description: Provides a string summary of a WakeWordGateMatch object, indicating if a match occurred and related info.
